name: World of Warships Companion
description: World of Warships catgirl companion: telemetry-only battle call-outs.
panel.title: World of Warships Companion
panel.subtitle: Read-only 8111 telemetry turns battle snapshots into events and lets the character phrase the selected call-out.
format.service.external: External service (not managed by the plugin)
overview.reconnectRequired: The data-source configuration changed. Select Reconnect data source to apply it.
overview.source.title: Data source
overview.transport.title: Transport and cursor
overview.cursor.help: Duplicate and out-of-order frames are dropped by (instanceId, seq) and transport epoch. These drops are normal deduplication.
overview.battle.title: Current battle
overview.battle.availabilityHelp: No data in this frame and stale are not negative facts. Dependent detectors are blocked instead of treating them as false.
overview.hint.conflict: Another service is answering on this port (War Thunder telemetry also uses 8111). Change the 8111_for_wows port or stop the conflicting service.
overview.hint.unreachable: The telemetry service is unreachable. Check service_url, or configure service_source_dir and reconnect.
overview.hint.no_snapshot: The service is connected but has not sent a snapshot yet.
overview.hint.waiting: The service is running but has no battle data. Confirm the in-game collector mod is installed and enter a battle.
overview.hint.stale: Telemetry stopped updating. The collector may have stopped writing because the game is minimized or the mod failed.
overview.hint.legacy: A legacy service without a v1 envelope is connected. Envelope fields are derived locally and battleId only guarantees a change between battles.
timeline.empty.title: No pipeline records yet
timeline.empty.description: Start the plugin and enter a battle to see important detection, arbitration, and delivery results.
timeline.help: Each row is an important pipeline result. When the character stays silent, this shows whether the plugin suppressed the call-out or submission failed.
timeline.detail.title: Details: {stage} / {outcome}
timeline.detail.preview: Complete prompt that dry-run would have submitted:
timeline.detail.select: Select a row to inspect its facts and prompt preview.
documents.unavailable: The document store could not be opened: {error}. Tactical references are optional; the rest of the pipeline is unaffected.
documents.help: Imported material is wording reference only. It is injected as untrusted reference text and cannot replace missing telemetry or override facts.
documents.indexTruncated: The corpus exceeds the ranking-index cap. Extra chunks remain tag-searchable but do not participate in BM25 ranking. Raise tactics_index_chunk_cap or import less content.
documents.quotas.title: Quotas
documents.import.title: Import
documents.import.fullscreenHelp: A native file dialog may appear behind a full-screen game. Use paste import below if that happens.

documents.list.columns.title: Title

documents.list.empty.description: Search returns no references when the store is empty. The pipeline continues normally.
documents.search.title: Latest search
documents.search.gateFallback: The reference-injection gate was not met
documents.search.empty: No search has run yet. Selected call-outs will show their reference hits and scores here.
prompts.help: Channel mode controls composition: dual uses base plus the matching overlay; single uses base only. Revisions affect wording, not priority, TTL, or preemption.
prompts.editor.title: Three-section editor
prompts.editor.invalid: All three sections are required and must remain within the limit. An invalid section rejects the whole bundle without changing the active revision.
prompts.preview.title: Local preview
prompts.preview.help: Build a complete prompt from the latest real candidate, or a built-in sample. Preview is local and never enters the message stream.
prompts.history.title: Revision history
prompts.history.empty: No custom revisions yet; built-in prompts are active.
preferences.intrusion.title: Conversation interruption
preferences.intrusion.help: The host already has a short gate after the user speaks. This is the longer configurable layer; the timeline identifies which layer suppressed a call-out.
preferences.promptChannel.title: Prompt channel
preferences.promptChannel.help: Channel mode changes wording only. Priority, TTL, and preemption are identical.
preferences.lanes.title: Broadcast lanes
preferences.lanes.help: Disabled lanes are rejected before queuing and consume no cooldown.
preferences.categories.title: Event categories
preferences.timing.title: Timing overrides
preferences.timing.help: Timing overrides last for this run only and return to configured values after restart.
diagnostics.broadcast.title: Battle call-outs
diagnostics.broadcast.dryRunHelp: With dry-run enabled, the complete pipeline builds a prompt and stops immediately before submission. Host calls should remain at zero.
diagnostics.broadcast.liveWarning: Live output is enabled and the character may speak proactively during battle. This setting lasts for this run only; restart returns to dry-run.
diagnostics.broadcast.preferencesHelp: Prompt channels, event categories, and interruption policy are on the Preferences page.
diagnostics.counts.title: Output counters
diagnostics.counts.dryRunViolation: Host calls must remain zero in dry-run. Please report this as a bug.
